title: Gammon and Leek Pie
subtitle: Chunks of gammon and soft leeks in a creamy sauce under a shortcrust lid
excerpt: Gammon pieces and slowly cooked leeks in a thick cream sauce, baked inside a shortcrust case. Proper cold-weather cooking.
sourceNotes: Traditional British pie using gammon steak, a pairing common in Northern English home cooking.

recipe.freezeNotes: Freeze the baked pie in slices. Reheat from frozen at 180C for 25 minutes.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Make the filling the day before. Add pastry and bake when ready.

content.text: Gammon is salty, so taste the filling before adding any extra salt. The leeks need to be completely soft before the filling goes in the pie or they will be stringy. Let everything cool before you line the dish.

items.prepNote: two thirds for the base, one third for the lid
white and pale green parts, sliced into rounds

content.text: Melt the butter in the frying pan over a medium-low heat. Add the leeks and cook gently for 12 minutes until completely soft. Stir regularly.
Add the gammon cubes and stir for 3 minutes. Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the milk gradually, stirring all the time. Add the cream and mustard. Simmer for 8 minutes until thick. Taste and add pepper. Leave to cool.
Heat the oven to 200C. Roll out two thirds of the pastry and line the pie dish with a small overhang. Chill for 20 minutes.
Pour the cooled filling into the pastry case. Roll the remaining pastry into a lid. Brush the rim with beaten egg and press the lid on firmly. Trim and crimp.
Brush the top with beaten egg and cut two slits in the centre.
Bake for 40 minutes until the pastry is deep gold. Rest for 10 minutes before cutting.

items.cause: Gammon is already cured and salty by nature.
items.fix: Taste the filling before it goes in the pastry. Do not add any extra salt at any stage.

items.cause: The filling was warm or the base was not blind-baked.
items.fix: Cool the filling fully. For a crisper base, blind-bake the case at 200C for 10 minutes before adding the filling.

items.cause: The milk was added too fast.
items.fix: Add the milk in three stages and stir vigorously after each addition before adding more.
